prompts.cover:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: finished premium illustrated wide 16:9 cover for the cooperative game Gravity Orchard, no text.
Create a warm, whimsical storybook painting, rich gouache and pencil, tactile paper grain, clean expressive silhouettes. A floating orchard high among cream clouds: exactly TWO broad suspended wooden garden trays, left and right, visibly joined by ONE short wooden bridge in the center. Readable at a 320 pixel wide collection thumbnail. The large wooden garden trays fill the lower two thirds, with fruit rolling visibly from left across the bridge to right.
On the left, Jon is a cheerful little anthropomorphic mouse with cream fur, large round pink mouse ears, short tousled brown hair, rectangular dark blue glasses, teal scarf, brown vest over cream shirt, simple brown satchel. He leans and gestures to send a red apple toward the bridge. On the right Lydia is a cheerful little anthropomorphic mouse with cream fur, large round pink mouse ears, long auburn braid, large round brown glasses, coral scarf, cream cardigan and russet skirt. She reaches to catch/guide the incoming fruit. A round smiling orange tabby cat Lala with cream muzzle, warm stripes and green eyes lounges beside a wicker picnic hamper and gingham cloth at the right outer edge; Lala is the third character, clearly a cat, not a mouse.
Four distinct fruits (red apple with leaf, oval purple plum with double leaves, yellow-green pear with narrow neck, golden five-point starfruit cross-section) are arranged in a few readable groups. Sparse blooming orchard trees at the far outside edges; deep sage leaves, honey wood, oat cream sky, warm sunlight. Visible dangling garden roots and hanging brass lanterns help convey floating altitude. Inviting team cooperation, dynamic graceful rolling arcs, no danger.
Composition: panoramic 16:9, full-bleed single painting, slightly elevated isometric view, clear central bridge and both trays, pleasing hierarchy and generous open sky above. Faces and bridge should remain prominent at small size. Keep all characters fully inside the frame with breathing room. Polished final game cover artwork, not a mockup.
Constraints: absolutely NO words, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, captions, UI cards or borders. No humans, no extra characters. Do not use a grid or a montage.
prompts.morning-delivery:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: finished 16:9 atmospheric background layer for a cozy top-down floating-orchard game, 1280x720 logical board. Original warm gouache and colored-pencil storybook illustration.
Stage: Morning Delivery. Airy pale cream and mint morning clouds above a distant softly painted valley, small warm sun diffused near upper left, tender sage orchard foliage entering only from the far extreme corners, sparse tiny cream blossoms and soft hanging roots at outer edge. A gentle honey sunlight wash. The entire central 80 percent is a quiet pale oat-to-sage cloud field of very low contrast, largely empty, with only soft diffuse texture. This quiet field will sit underneath two separately rendered wooden garden trays with exact collision geometry.
Keep all detailed plants/branches/flowers in the outermost 8 percent border, irregular natural framing rather than a hard border. Elegant layered paper/gouache texture. Landscape 16:9 full bleed, no vignetting that darkens the board. Mood: safe, open, bright first morning, warm whimsical orchard in the sky.
CRITICAL: This is ONLY a decorative atmosphere backdrop, NOT a level map. No trays, paths, bridges, hedges, gates, holes, baskets, fruit, characters, interface, arrows, text, writing, numbers, logos or labels. No solid dark shapes in the center that could be mistaken for game obstacles. No mockup framing, no inset panels.
